decision_rules.falsified: All of 001, 002, 003, 005 have judged error > 0.021. Cite only those four (all in-domain). Comment: failure confined to window ends where the paper's own model passes near contact.
decision_rules.replicated: All of 001, 002, 003, 005 have judged error <= 0.021 (and the control 004 too). Cite >=3 of them. Comment: the judged metric is at the noise floor and cannot test K(r).
decision_rules.narrowed: Mixed: the control 004 and at least one edge run disagree (for example r0=3 fails at T=1.5 but passes at T=1.0). Propose the narrowed domain in proposed_domain and cite the passing runs.
decision_rules.inconclusive: Otherwise, e.g. edge runs give errors between 0.007 and 0.021 without a clear split.

not_to_do: Do not file before the round 3 results exist; the review evidence must be results that were scored.
Do not cite runs that the paper model refuses (out of window) or that are out of domain: they cannot count.
Do not use research-account runs as review evidence.
